rationale: Cosine LR schedule 1e-4 -> 1e-6 over 8 epochs (Loshchilov 2017). Complement to SWA: flat optimum naturally without snapshot averaging.
advice_for_others: DISCARD: hr=0.5700 vs 0.5807 (-1.07pp). Confirms iter-11 finding: model is LR-LIMITED at 8 epochs with lr=1e-4, NOT flatness-limited. Cosine decay starves late-training learning rate when loss is still actively decreasing. Lesson for other agents: do NOT use cosine/SWA/decay on 8-epoch budget; the bottleneck is total step distance not noise around an optimum. Try a HIGHER fixed lr instead.
